commands.title: New Terminal
commands.description: Open a new login-shell terminal in the workspace and focus it.

cwd.description: Working directory; the first workspace folder (or home) when absent.

commands.title: Close Terminal
commands.description: Close a terminal session, killing whatever runs in it; a no-op when the session is absent or unknown.

commands.title: Terminal Busy
commands.description: Report whether a terminal session is running a process besides its shell.

sessionId.description: Session to check; an unknown or exited one is not busy.

busy.description: Whether a descendant of the shell is alive.

process.description: Name of the newest such process; empty when not busy.
